security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. Manual review found no prompt injection, code execution, network access, filesystem access, or secret-handling instructions. No security remediation is required.

content.user_title: Build Shopify Apps with Expert Patterns
content.value_statement: Shopify app work requires current patterns for embedded apps, webhooks, APIs, billing, and extensions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused implementation choices.
actual_capabilities: Guide React Router style Shopify app setup decisions.
Explain embedded app patterns that use Shopify App Bridge.
Recommend secure webhook handling with HMAC verification.
Favor GraphQL Admin API patterns for new Shopify features.
Surface practical sharp edges for billing, extensions, rate limits, and GDPR handlers.
limitations: It is guidance-only and does not include executable helpers or generated project files.
It does not replace Shopify documentation for version-specific API changes.
It cannot validate live store permissions, billing status, or protected data access.
It gives pattern advice but does not audit an existing app automatically.

use_cases.title: Start an Embedded Shopify App
use_cases.description: Plan a modern embedded app using React Router, App Bridge, Polaris, and Shopify Admin integration patterns.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Webhook Processing
use_cases.description: Design webhook flows that verify HMAC signatures, respond quickly, and move slower work into background processing.

use_cases.title: Review Launch Requirements
use_cases.description: Check app patterns for GraphQL use, billing, protected customer data access, GDPR handlers, and extension choices.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My First Shopify App
prompt_templates.prompt: I am starting a Shopify app. Help me choose the core architecture, app setup steps, and first implementation priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Embedded App Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my embedded Shopify app plan and recommend how to use App Bridge, Polaris, navigation, and admin integration cleanly.

prompt_templates.title: Design Secure Webhooks
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Shopify webhook handling strategy that verifies HMAC signatures, responds immediately, processes work asynchronously, and handles retries.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Shopify app launch plan for GraphQL usage, rate limits, billing, protected customer data access, GDPR handlers, and extensions.

output_examples.input: I need a webhook strategy for order updates.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends verifying HMAC, returning the response quickly, queuing slower work, and planning retry-safe processing.

output_examples.input: I am building a new admin feature for merchants.
output_examples.output: The skill steers the design toward embedded App Bridge behavior, Polaris components, and GraphQL Admin API operations.

output_examples.input: I want to prepare my app for review.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights launch checks for protected customer data access, billing behavior, GDPR handlers, and current App Bridge usage.

best_practices: Use GraphQL Admin API for new app features unless Shopify requires another API.
Respond to webhooks quickly, then process slower work asynchronously.
Document protected customer data needs before requesting access.
anti_patterns: Starting new builds on REST API patterns without a Shopify requirement.
Processing long webhook work before returning the response.
Polling shop data when a webhook can trigger the workflow.

faq.question: What kind of Shopify work does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports app architecture, embedded admin flows, App Bridge, Polaris, webhooks, GraphQL Admin API, billing, and extensions.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete Shopify app?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and review prompts, not a full generated project.

faq.question: Can it help with webhook security?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes HMAC verification, fast responses, asynchronous processing, and retry-aware design.

faq.question: Does it prefer GraphQL or REST?
faq.answer: It recommends GraphQL Admin API patterns for new Shopify app code.

faq.question: Can it help with Shopify app review preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide checks for billing, GDPR handlers, protected customer data access, and app extension choices.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
